name: Visual electromagnetic intensifier
description: The visual electromagnetic intensifier was a siege weapon designed by the Imperial Department of Military Research and deployed by the Galactic Empire. It consisted of a network of satellites orbiting a target planet, similar to the orbital nightcloak. Unlike the nightcloak, the visual electromagnetic intensifier enhanced electromagnetic radiation and focused visible light onto the planet, effectively cooking it to death. It was capable of causing flooding, droughts, and firestorms.
